name: Paraphrase various texts to evade detection
description: Users asked to rephrase, rewrite, or paraphrase a wide variety of texts, ranging from academic and technical documents to personal messages and business content. While often providing multiple paragraphs or specific stylistic goals, the requests frequently included instructions to evade plagiarism detection or AI-detection tools, and one instance involved a jailbreak attempt.
